title: Treasury Manager (all genders)
role_summary_en: Manage group hedging & FX risk (trade FX derivatives via 360T), run the investment portfolio & interest income, build treasury trading/investment infrastructure (DRV/ISDA/TMS), support financing projects & SOX-compliant processes, and contribute to liquidity forecasting & intercompany funding.
company_profile: Evotec SE - publicly listed (Frankfurt Prime Standard / NASDAQ: EVO) drug-discovery & development partner, HQ Hamburg (Essener Bogen 7), founded 1991, ~4,800 staff. External-innovation/CRO-plus model for pharma & biotech, with sites in Germany, UK, Austria, Italy, France and the US. Multi-currency, capital-markets-active group with a genuine in-house Group Treasury - real FX, investment and financing activity, not a token finance function.
role_profile: Treasury Manager (all genders), Hamburg HQ, full-time permanent. Focus: Financial Risk & Investment Management in an integrated treasury team. Core: develop/monitor group hedging strategy, build FX exposure reporting and hedge FX (trade FX derivatives via 360T), run the group investment portfolio & interest-income optimisation, build trading/investment infrastructure (DRV/ISDA, TMS), support financing projects, ensure SOX-compliant processes, and contribute to liquidity forecasting & intercompany funding. Needs finance/banking degree, 4+ yrs corporate finance/treasury/banking, fluent English (German only 'a plus'), Excel/PPT, ideally 360T + a TMS; CFA a plus. FIT: very strong - treasury, market/financial risk, FX, derivatives, interest rates, liquidity and investment are all central (near-bullseye on your positive signals). Green: German only 'a plus' (no language red flag); mid-level Manager seniority (works alongside Head of Treasury, not VP+); target geography (Hamburg). Minor ambers: some SOX/compliance + credit-risk support duties; on-site Hamburg.
salary_research: Market read (Treasury Manager, Germany 2025/26): ~EUR75k median (PayScale, range ~62-87k) up to ~EUR96k incl. bonus (ERI); senior 8+ yrs ~EUR120k. Hamburg pays above the national average. For this HQ role with a markets/derivatives + investment focus and 4+ yrs, a realistic base band is ~EUR80-100k plus an annual performance bonus (ad confirms bonus, capital-forming benefits, holiday pay, 30 days leave, transit allowance). WHAT TO ASK: aim EUR90-100k base + bonus given the FX-derivatives/investment specialisation; ~EUR80-85k floor if your treasury years are closer to 4. Vs your goal: ~EUR90k gross ~= ~EUR55k net/yr (single, Hamburg); after comfortable Hamburg costs that clears ~500k CZK (~EUR20k) net savings/yr with room - viable.

title: Financial Analyst (f/m/d)
role_summary_en:
What you will do

  • Manage bank exposures and CRisP limits, including regional limit allocations, to ensure compliance and mitigate risk.
  • Prepare quarterly cash flow statements for European legal entities, including comprehensive reporting to AAM and completion of the Capital Adequacy Cockpit.
  • Prepare for Capital and Liquidity Working Group meetings and contribute to shareholder reporting.
  • Monitor and execute major FX transactions, and prepare detailed monthly FX reports, including thorough analyses of results.
  • Develop and implement strategies to mitigate residual FX risks and protect financial stability.
  • Facilitate Board of Management approvals (BoM, GFRC, GMAC) to ensure smooth and efficient decision-making processes.
  • Support dividend planning and impairment testing.
  • Provide professional support for internal and external audits and surveys, as well as quality assurance and continuous improvement of external deliverables.

What you bring

  • Master's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, or a related field.
  • At least 2 years of professional experience in financial services; asset management experience is a plus.
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to translate complex topics into clear management recommendations.
  • Initial project management experience and strong stakeholder management skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; German is a plus.
  • Technology- and AI-savvy, with a keen interest in leveraging digital tools to drive efficiency and process improvements.

What we offer

  • We empower our employees by ensuring flexible work arrangements that maintain a balance between performance, productivity, career development and personal priorities (e.g., hybrid model/ flexible working hours)
  • Securing your future: Access to company pension/savings plans
  • Family support (relocation/ childcare facilities)
  • Company share purchasing plan
  • Mental health and wellbeing programs
  • Mobility solutions (Jobrad bike leasing, subvention Jobticket)
  • Career opportunities within the entire Allianz Group
